proper = {name.lower(): name for name in ('Karbala Shabbir Kausar Zam Hasan Sarwar Asghar Abbas Muharram Sakina Kaaba Aashur Anoo Kazim Allah').split()}

assert number == 10

roman_yaml = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in '\\n\\n'.join(blocks).splitlines())
p.write_text(f\"---\\n{header}\\nromanLyrics: |-\\n{roman_yaml}\\n---\\n\\n\" + '\\n\\n'.join(source) + '\\n')
